to undertake; to attempt; to accomplish
eight-fold; in eight parts or sections
into an unlimited number of pieces or parts

tr.text: Verily, in the beginning this world was Darkness (tamas) alone. That, of course, would be in the Supreme. When impelled by the Supreme, that goes on to differentiation. That form, verily’, is Passion [rajas). That Passion, in turn, when impelled, goes on to differentiation. That, verily, is the form of Purity (sattva). That Purity, when impelled, flowed forth as Essence (rasa). That part is what the intelligence-mass here in every person is — the spirit which has the marks of conception, determination, and self-conceit, Prajāpati (Lord of Creation) under the name individuality. These forms of Him have previously been mentioned. Now then, assuredly, indeed, the part of Him which is characterized by Darkness (tamas) — that, O ye students of sacred knowledge, is this Rudra. Now then, assuredly, indeed, the part of Him which is characterized by’ Passion (rajas) — that, O ye students of sacred knowledge, is this Brahma. Now then, assuredly, indeed, the part of Him which is 5.2-1 characterized by Purity (sattva) — that, O ye students of sacred knowledge, is this Vishnu. Verily, that One became threefold. He developed forth eightfold, elevenfold, twelvefold, into an infinite number of parts. Because of having developed forth, He is a created being (bhiita); has entered into and moves among created beings; He became the overlord of created beings. That is the Soul (Ātman) within and without — yea, within and without!

sa: पञ्चमः प्रपाठकः॥ अथ यथेयं कौत्सायनिस्तुतिः ॥ त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं च वै विष्णुस्त्वं रुद्रस्त्वं प्रजापतिः ।
iast: pañcamaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ॥ atha yatheyaṃ kautsāyanistutiḥ ॥ tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ ca vai viṣṇustvaṃ rudrastvaṃ prajāpatiḥ ।
words: to praise; to celebrate; to extol
the moon (with divā-kara among the sons of Garuḍa); name of a Ṛṣi; name of the number 1

tr.text: Now, then, this is Kutsayana’s Hymn of Praise. — Thou art Brahma, and verily thou art Vishnu. Thou art Rudra. Thou art Prajāpati. Thou art Agni, Varuṇa, and Vayu. Thou art Indra. Thou art the Moon.

sa: त्वं मनुस्त्वं यमश्च त्वं पृथिवी त्वमथाच्युतः ।
स्वार्थे स्वाभाविकेऽर्थे च बहुधा तिष्ठसे दिवि
iast: tvaṃ manustvaṃ yamaśca tvaṃ pṛthivī tvamathācyutaḥ ।
svārthe svābhāvike'rthe ca bahudhā tiṣṭhase divi

tr.text: Thou art food. Thou art Yarna. Thou art the Earth. Thou art All. Yea, thou art the unshaken one! For Nature’s sake and for its own Is existence manifold in thee.
O Lord of all, hail unto thee 1 The Soul of all, causing all acts, Enjoying all, all life art thou! Lord (prabhn) of all pleasure and delight I

sa: नमः शान्तात्मने तुभ्यं नमो गुह्यतमाय च ।
iast: namaḥ śāntātmane tubhyaṃ namo guhyatamāya ca ।

tr.text: Hail unto thee, O Tranquil Soul Yea, hail to thee, most hidden one, Unthinkable, unlimited, Beginningless and endless, too!
